title: The Night the Lighthouse Hiccupped | Bedtime Read-Aloud for Ages 4–7
description:
One big hiccup sends a lighthouse bouncing right off its hill. Mira and her feathered friend Pip follow its bobbing beam through the woods and into the fog, helping it find its footing so it can guide the boats home.

This Giggle & Snooze picture book gives kids ages 4–7 a funny adventure that settles into a quiet bedtime rhythm. Mira’s soft voice and the friends’ long, gentle exhale give you a moment to slow down together. By the time the boats are tucked in, there’s cocoa, a cozy basket for Pip, and a golden light sweeping over the sea.
